rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose expression for a being capable of awareness, sensation, or thought.

example.english: Scientists still aren't sure whether this alien creature is sentient.
example.traditional: 科學家仲未肯定呢種外星生物係咪有知覺。
example.jyutping: fo1 hok6 gaa1 zung6 mei6 hang2 ding6 ni1 zung2 ngoi6 sing1 sang1 mat6 hai6 mai6 jau5 zi1 gok3

rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is on being able to experience sensations or feelings rather than on consciousness generally.

example.english: Although it can't speak, it is still sentient.
example.traditional: 佢雖然唔識講嘢，但都係有感受㗎。
example.jyutping: keoi5 seoi1 jin4 m4 sik1 gong2 je5 daan6 dou1 hai6 jau5 gam2 sau6 gaa3

rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is on the ability to think, especially in contrast with something completely mindless.

example.english: The robot doesn't just move around; it is genuinely sentient.
example.traditional: 部機械人唔係淨係郁下郁下，佢真係識諗嘢。
example.jyutping: bou6 gei1 haai6 jan4 m4 hai6 zing6 hai6 juk1 haa5 juk1 haa5 keoi5 zan1 hai6 sik1 nam2 je5
